Title: Library Returned Books Design Patterns Quiz

Intended changes:
- Q1: re-theme the question text and all answer options to the library returned books domain, keep exactly one correct option
- Q2: re-theme the scenario (ticker, widgets) to a library notification service and its subscribers, adjust wording of answer options accordingly, keep the same correctness distribution
- Q3: re-theme the integration of a third‑party payment SDK to a library integrating a third‑party catalog API, keep answer options and correctness unchanged
- Q4: re-theme the singleton configuration class to a library configuration component, keep answer options and correctness unchanged
- Q5: re-theme the plug‑in shape creation scenario to a library plug‑in that provides new report formats, keep answer options and correctness unchanged
- Q6: re-theme the template method example to a library report generator for overdue notices, keep answer options and correctness unchanged
- Q7: re-theme the large Report class smell to a library Report class with disjoint responsibilities, keep answer options and correctness unchanged
- Q8: re-theme the short‑answer spots to a library return‑processing pipeline (e.g., fee calculation, notification, audit logging) while preserving the three required pattern names (Decorator, Proxy, State)
- Q9: re-theme the short‑answer spots to a library catalog sorting tool, preserving the class names Context, SortStrategy, and Policy as answers
- Q10: re-theme the short‑answer spots to a library order service review, preserving the SOLID abbreviation (DIP) and the technique name (dependency injection or constructor injection) as answers

Invariants:
- The number of questions, their order, and their types (multiple‑choice, short‑answer) stay unchanged
- Scoring type and points of every question stay unchanged
- The number of correct answer options per multiple‑choice question stays unchanged
- All hint and explanation texts remain attached to their respective options, only wording is re‑themed
- No new answer options are added or removed; only the textual content is adapted to the library domain
- All spot IDs, solution IDs, and correctMappings for short‑answer questions remain unchanged

Problem statement:
This quiz assesses understanding of design patterns in the context of a library's returned books system.
